title: Going Through My Personal Album Collection
description:

This is my take on the daily vlog concept. 

Everyday I upload a 4 minute vlog, shot 4 minutes after the day before. 

There’s no editing, no re-takes and no music over-dubs and they always finish right on the 4 minute mark, no exceptions.
